prompt:
Our team just finished building the internal terminal dashboard for the trading desk — three Go source files located in the `tradedash/internal/ui/` directory: `dashboard.go`, `orderform.go`, and `watchlist.go`. Before we push to production, I need a thorough code review of all three files.

Please produce a structured review report saved as `code_review_report.json` in the workspace root. The report must clearly list every real bug you find (with the filename, a description of the problem, and why it's harmful), and it must also note any patterns that look suspicious but are actually correct — I don't want the dev team chasing phantom issues.

Be especially careful: some patterns in these files might look wrong at first glance but are actually the intended, idiomatic way to write this kind of code. Getting the false positives right is just as important as finding the real bugs.
